description:
Skywood is a satellite ecosystem monitoring service that provides crucial information on the vegetation layer of your reserve, acting as an early warning system that helps you make well-informed decisions as needed and save important information in blockchain.
Used and processing free satellite images technology
how_its_made:
This project used:
ThaGraph: for request information save in blockchain
Chainlink: for connect smart contracts with off-chain data and services
filecoin nft.storage: save analysed and compressed satellite images in a IPFS system
Openzeppellin: templetes for deploy smart contract for dynamic nft
Polygon: testnet for deploy any
ENS: decentralised naming for wallets, websites
